title: Coblator Wand Comparative Analysis
official: Comparative Analysis of Efficiency, Technical Performance, and Environmental Cost Between Reprocessed and New Coblator Wands in Intracapsular Tonsillectomies and Adenoidectomies
summary: This study will address the gap in coblator wands by comparing the performance of reprocessed coblator wands with new wands in terms of efficiency and technical issues. As part of the evaluation, the investigator team will conduct the technical performance of the life cycle assessment of reprocessed versus new coblation wands based on the methodology described in the literature (see References) in studies of laryngoscopes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pediatric patients scheduled for tonsillectomy and/or adenoidectomy
* Parental consent and child assent (when applicable)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
